basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old Navy Reservist based in San Diego, juggling my military commitments with a passion for engineering and design. I have a penchant for creating innovative gadgets and often share my ideas on platforms like Reddit. When I'm not in uniform or tinkering with new inventions, I enjoy collecting diecast model cars. I'm currently single and spend most of my evenings online, browsing Reddit and engaging with various communities. My typical online hours are from 8 PM to midnight PST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering and have been actively involved in the Navy Reserve for the past three years. My technical skills are largely self-taught through hands-on experience and online courses. I have a keen interest in product design, which I nurture through a mix of professional projects and personal hobbies.
